figures.finding: A screenwriter in Bosnia and Herzegovina can join the Association of Filmmakers of BiH (Sarajevo, founded 1950), open to anyone working professionally in an audiovisual sector, by emailing an application with ID, diploma, biography, filmography, photograph and a current member's recommendation. No writers' collective agreement or minimum fee was found.

value.union: Udruženje filmskih radnika u Bosni i Hercegovini (Association of Filmmakers of BiH)

sources.said: If you wish to become a member of the Association of Film Workers and you work professionally in one of the audio-visual sectors, you need to send your application for membership to the email address … A detailed filmography … A membership recommendation from a current member of the Association of Film Workers on one page
The Association of Filmmakers of Bosnia and Herzegovina is a professional association which gathers filmmakers, who are professionally engaged in filmmaking and was founded in 1950.

figures.finding: Under Bosnia and Herzegovina's 2010 copyright law, as the Association states it, the author of the script is a co-author of an audiovisual work and keeps, untransferably, the moral right to object to any modification or use that would offend his or her honour and reputation; the economic rights (reproduction, distribution, communication, adaptation) can be transferred to the producer.

value.law: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2010)

sources.said: In Bosnia and Herzegovina, the laws regulating this field are the Law on Copyright and Related Rights and the Law on Collective Management of Copyright and Related Rights, which were enacted in 2010. … The non-transferable moral rights of the author include: … the right to object to any modification or use of the work that would offend their honor and reputation; … Co-authors of an audiovisual work are considered to be: the author of adaptation; the main director; the author of the script;
